email.subject: Bit -- Propagation
email.body:
Are you seeing this network? There's that new security scattered about on almost everything, but I'm picking my way through it - there are still a few holes, but progress is slow.
I've attached the IP of what I'm looking into now. From the side I'm coming at it from I cant see any cracks in it yet - are you having any luck? If you find its admin pass, reply to this email with it - I get the feeling that server's the key to where Bit fits into all this.
The talk of this "Hacknet project" showing up is kinda worrying too... Have you ever heard of that? A whole OS re-write... We can look into that later. For now, see if you can find a way into this relay - we'll work out our next step after that.
I'd probably look around their production and store servers - "Prometheus" and "Romulus" etc. A way in might be anywhere though.
Good luck, -V
